whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Chai34,

I noticed your café has a strong 4.7★ rating in Maurya Lok Complex, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and takeaway orders.

Maine aapke café ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp ordering, menu showcase, aur table booking integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/chai34

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Chai34, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke café (Chai34) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a digital menu showcase and direct WhatsApp table booking right from Maurya Lok Complex. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items, photos aur contact setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
